title: Nonlinear GENERIC-Embedded Neural Networks (N-GENNs): Learning GENERIC dynamics with non-quadratic dissipation potentials
abstract: arXiv:2605.09058v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce Nonlinear GENERIC-Embedded Neural Networks (N-GENNs), a deep learning framework for discovering evolution equations of systems governed by the nonlinear GENERIC formalism (General Equation for Non-Equilibrium Reversible-Irreversible Coupling). Such systems exhibit coupled conservative and dissipative dynamics, and can be described via the superposition of a Hamiltonian flow and a generalized gradient flow. In contrast to existing approaches, our formulation incorporates generalized gradient flows via convex dissipation potentials, enabling the identification of a broader class of thermodynamically consistent dynamics, including systems with non-quadratic dissipation potentials. Thermodynamic structure is strongly enforced by construction through suitable reparameterizations of both the reversible operator and the dissipation potential, ensuring exact compliance with the first and second laws of thermodynamics. translated_title: 非线性GENERIC嵌入神经网络（N-GENNs）：学习具有非二次耗散势的GENERIC动力学
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.09058v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：我们引入了非线性GENERIC嵌入神经网络（N-GENNs），这是一种深度学习框架，用于发现由非线性GENERIC形式体系（非平衡可逆-不可逆耦合通用方程）控制的系统的演化方程。此类系统表现出耦合的保守和耗散动力学，可以通过哈密顿流和广义梯度流的叠加来描述。与现有方法相比，我们的公式通过凸耗散势整合了广义梯度流，从而能够识别更广泛的热力学一致动力学类别，包括具有非二次耗散势的系统。热力学结构通过适当重新参数化可逆算子和耗散势而被强有力地构建，确保严格符合热力学第一和第二定律。我们验证了该方法在多种基准问题上的有效性。
tldr: 本文提出N-GENNs，一种通过凸耗散势嵌入非线性GENERIC形式的新神经网络框架，能够识别包括非二次耗散势在内的更广泛热力学一致动力学，并严格确保热力学定律的满足。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces N-GENNs, a novel neural network framework embedding the nonlinear GENERIC formalism via convex dissipation potentials, enabling identification of a broader class of thermodynamically consistent dynamics including non-quadratic dissipation potentials while strictly ensuring thermodynamic law compliance.
